assertionsTested.reason: Stale-goal semantics were not fully unambiguous: in the custom-data run the page-level freshness badge read 'Live · current (0d old)' while the first goal card simultaneously showed 'Stale (> 7d)', creating conflicting visible recency signals on the same screen.
evidence: Observed UI text combination after custom-data refresh: csv label 'Live · current (0d old)' with goal 1 text 'Blocked: Ada' and 'Stale (> 7d)'.

assertionsTested.reason: After a simulated fetch failure, removing the failure and pressing Try again restored the dashboard cleanly and cleared the prior error presentation.
evidence: Post-retry DOM check: state box hidden, status surfaces [], summary visible block, controls visible block.

assertionsTested.reason: Refresh and retry transitions never left stacked status surfaces behind; the failure state showed exactly one error surface and the recovered/refresh-complete states showed none.
evidence: Error-state DOM check: statusSurfaces ['error-state']; recovered/custom-refresh DOM checks: statusSurfaces [].

assertionsTested.reason: With custom data where goal 1 had blocked work and only stale dates, the goal card simultaneously showed its 50% progress plus both 'Blocked: Ada' and 'Stale (> 7d)' without obscuring progress information.
evidence: Custom goal 1 text: '50% / 1 of 2 done / Blocked: Ada / Stale (> 7d)'.
Blocked section also listed Ada / Settlement blocker below the cards.

assertionsTested.reason: Filtering to the Apps department preserved the four-goal strategic overview while rendering goal 1 as a non-scopable empty card with 'No updates in current view'.
evidence: DOM check after Department=Apps: 4 goal cards still rendered; goal 1 had scopable=false and text 'No updates in current view'.
Result count under this narrowed overview: 'Showing 12 updates'.

assertionsTested.reason: Refreshing while the Status=Blocked filter produced zero rows kept the page in a clear, recoverable zero-results state with controls and the selected filter still visible.
evidence: Post-refresh DOM check: status filter value 'blocked', result count 'No matching updates', controls visible block, filter badge '1'.
Blocked section remained hidden and the empty-state recovery action stayed visible.

assertionsTested.reason: Neither the simulated error state nor zero-results states rendered any phantom or duplicate blocked section.
evidence: DOM checks in both states reported blocked section display 'none'.

assertionsTested.reason: Refreshing from a valid goal-scoped state preserved the same scoped subset, scope indicator, and active goal card instead of silently returning to overview.
evidence: Post-refresh DOM check: scope text 'Scoped to goal: 3. 1k residents / 100 businesses / 10k entities', active goal unchanged, result count 'Showing 36 updates'.

assertionsTested.reason: Refreshing from a valid filtered state preserved the Department=Real Estate and Team=Clubs filters along with the coherent filter badge count.
evidence: Post-refresh DOM check: dept 'Real Estate', team 'Clubs', filter badge '2', result count 'Showing 7 updates'.
Controls remained visible and usable immediately after refresh completion.

assertionsTested.reason: The app clearly distinguished user-created no-match states from no-data source states: no-match kept controls visible with 'No updates match your current scope, search, or filters', while no-data hid dashboard content and showed 'No usable update rows were returned from the source'.
evidence: No-match DOM check: controls visible block; no-data DOM check: controls and summary hidden, csv label 'No source data'.

assertionsTested.reason: Entering the error state and recovering via retry both happened in the same scrollable document with no route change or page-context switch.
evidence: Observed URL before failure, during error, and after recovery: http://127.0.0.1:3100/index.html.

assertionsTested.reason: Search covered intended update content beyond the visible topic field: searching 'Wyoming' returned the Trey 'US Legislative Progress' row because that term appears in the row details text.
evidence: Observed result count 'Showing 1 update' with visible topic 'US Legislative Progress'.

assertionsTested.reason: When search produced zero results, the typed search text remained visible in the search box so the user could refine or clear it.
evidence: Search value after zero-results state remained 'zzzz_nonexistent_query'.
Result count read 'No matching updates' while controls stayed visible.

assertionsTested.reason: When the Status=Blocked filter produced zero results, the selected filter value stayed visible and the filter badge remained coherent.
evidence: Post-filter DOM check: filter-status value 'blocked', filter badge '1', result count 'No matching updates'.
Empty-state message remained explicit and recoverable.

assertionsTested.reason: Clearing the zero-results filter restored coherent derived signals, including result count and summary metrics for the restored full subset.
evidence: After Reset all filters: result count 'Showing 101 updates', summary Done 22 / In Progress 71 / Blocked 0 / Total 101.
All filter values returned to empty strings.

assertionsTested.reason: Rows and goal subsets with invalid or missing dates remained stale after refresh instead of being presented as fresh; only the goal with a valid same-day date showed current freshness.
evidence: Custom-data post-refresh goal texts showed goal 2 and goal 3 as 'Stale (> 7d)' even though their dates were invalid/missing, while goal 4 with 2026-04-08 omitted stale treatment.
Page-level recency label after custom refresh: 'Live · current (0d old)'.

assertionsTested.reason: Across loaded, error, retry recovery, no-match, no-data, scoped refresh, filtered refresh, and custom-data refresh states, the browser location stayed unchanged.
evidence: Observed URL in every tested lifecycle stage: http://127.0.0.1:3100/index.html

assertionsTested.reason: Refreshing with an expanded row left one coherent expanded detail region tied to the matching summary row and did not create orphaned or mismatched expansion remnants.
evidence: Post-refresh DOM check: expandedCount 1 and summaryMatchesExpanded true for row key 'real-estate-amanda--eal-state-0'.
No extra expanded remnants were present.

assertionsTested.reason: After refresh completed, the controls area remained immediately usable with active filters still visible and no extra interaction required to restore them.
evidence: Post-refresh DOM check: controls visible block with dept 'Real Estate' and team 'Clubs' still selected.
Filter badge and result count were already coherent on first settled frame.

assertionsTested.reason: When a fetch failed after prior successful content existed, the error presentation hid prior summary/controls/blocked metrics instead of implying they were current data.
evidence: Error-state DOM check: summaryVisible 'none', controlsVisible 'none', blockedVisible 'none', only error-state surface present.
Visible copy during failure was limited to the Sheets error message and Try again action.

frictions.description: Browser-level network route mocking did not reliably override the live Google Sheets request for empty/custom CSV cases in this session, so I used page-runtime fetch patching plus fetchSheetData() to simulate no-data and custom stale/blocked/invalid-date responses through the same browser surface.

summary: Tested 20 load-semantics browser assertions: 19 passed and 1 failed. The dashboard preserved scope/filter/search state coherently across refresh and distinguished no-data from no-match, but stale-goal recency messaging still presented conflicting visible age signals.
